plan: 2 Samuel 6:12a; 1 Chronicles 15:1-28; 2 Samuel 6:12b-15, 16; 1 Chronicles 15:29; 2 Samuel 6:17-19a; 1 Chronicles 16:1-6, 7-36, 37-42, 43; 2 Samuel 6:19b-23

readings.subsection: The Ark and the Breach of Protocol
readings.title: Transporting the Guarantee: The Unlawful Wagon
readings.subtitle: A Zeal Lacking the Architecture of Torah
readings.text: [2 Samuel 6:1] Now Daviḍ again gathered <dn>את</dn> all the chosen men of Yisra’ĕl, thirty thousand. [2] And Daviḍ rose up and went with all the people who were with him from Ba‘alĕ Yehuḍah, to bring up from there <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn>, that is called by the Name, the Name <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of Hosts, who dwells between the keruḇim. [3] And they placed <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn> on a new wagon, and brought it from the house of Aḇinaḍaḇ, which was on the hill. And Uzzah and Aḥyo, sons of Aḇinaḍaḇ, were leading <dn>את</dn> the new wagon. [4] And they brought it from the house of Aḇinaḍaḇ, which was on the hill, with the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn>. And Aḥyo was walking before the ark. [5] And Daviḍ and all the house of Yisra’ĕl were dancing before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, with all instruments of fir wood, and with lyres, and with harps, and with tambourines, and with sistrums, and with cymbals.

readings.title: The Fatal Consequences of Unauthorized Access
readings.subtitle: The Strict Reality of the Divine Presence (Kavod)
readings.text: [2 Samuel 6:6] And when they came to the threshing-floor of Naḵon, Uzzah reached out toward the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn> and took hold of it, for the oxen stumbled. [7] And the wrath of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> burned against Uzzah, and <dn>Elohim</dn> struck him there for the fault. And he died there by the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn>. [8] And Daviḍ was displeased because <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had broken out against Uzzah. And he called <dn>את</dn> the name of the place Perets Uzzah, until this day. [9] And Daviḍ was afraid of <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> on that day, and said, “How shall the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> come to me?” [10] And Daviḍ would not move <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with him into the City of Daviḍ, but Daviḍ turned it aside to the house of Oḇĕḍ-Eḍom the Gittite. [11] And the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> remained in the house of Oḇĕḍ-Eḍom the Gittite three new moons, and <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> blessed <dn>את</dn> Oḇĕḍ-Eḍom and <dn>את</dn> all his house.

readings.section: The Architecture of Justice & Civil Architecture
readings.title: Returning to the Levitical Order
readings.subtitle: Acknowledging the Authorized Bearers of the Ark
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 15:1] And he built houses for himself in the City of Daviḍ. And he prepared a place for the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn>, and pitched a tent for it. [2] Then Daviḍ said, “No one is to lift <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn> but the Lĕvites, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has chosen them to lift <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn> and to serve <dn>Him</dn> forever.” [3] And Daviḍ assembled <dn>את</dn> all Yisra’ĕl at Yerushalayim, to bring up <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to its place, which he had prepared for it.

readings.title: The Heads of the Fathers' Houses
readings.subtitle: Structuring the Human Bearers
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 15:4] And Daviḍ gathered <dn>את</dn> the children of Aharon and <dn>את</dn> the Lĕvites; [5] of the sons of Qehath: Uri’ĕl the chief, and one hundred and twenty of his brothers; [6] of the sons of Merari: Asayah the chief, and two hundred and twenty of his brothers; [7] of the sons of Gĕreshom: Yo’ĕl the chief, and one hundred and thirty of his brothers; [8] of the sons of Elitsaphan: Shemayah the chief, and two hundred of his brothers; [9] of the sons of Ḥeḇron: Eli’ĕl the chief, and eighty of his brothers; [10] of the sons of Uzzi’ĕl: Amminaḍaḇ the chief, and one hundred and twelve of his brothers.

readings.title: Restoring the Proper Architecture of Torah
readings.subtitle: Bearing the Kavod on Human Shoulders
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 15:11] And Daviḍ called for Tsaḍoq and Eḇyathar the priests, and for the Lĕvites, for Uri’ĕl, Asayah, and Yo’ĕl, Shemayah, and Eli’ĕl, and Amminaḍaḇ, [12] and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Lĕvites. Set yourselves apart, you and your brothers, then you shall bring up <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ĕl to the place I have prepared for it. [13] “Because you did not do it the first time, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn> broke out against us, because we did not ask <dn>Him</dn> about the right-ruling.” [14] So the priests and the Lĕvites set themselves apart, to bring up <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ĕl. [15] And the children of the Lĕvites bore <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn> on their shoulders, by its poles, as Mosheh had commanded according to the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: Establishing Functional Harmony (Tov) Before the Ark
readings.subtitle: Lifting Up the Voice With Joy
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 15:16] And Daviḍ spoke to the leaders of the Lĕvites to appoint <dn>את</dn> their brothers the singers with instruments of song, harps, and lyres, and cymbals, to lift up the voice with joy. [17] And the Lĕvites appointed <dn>את</dn> Hĕman son of Yo’ĕl, and of his brothers, Asaph son of Bereḵyahu; and of their brothers, the sons of Merari, Ĕythan son of Qushayahu; [18] and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zeḵaryahu, Bĕn, and Ya‘azi’ĕl, and Shemiramoth, and Yeḥi’ĕl, and Unni, Eliyaḇ, and Benayahu, and Ma‘asĕyahu, and Mattithyahu, and Eliphelĕhu, and Miqnĕyahu, and Oḇĕḍ-Eḍom, and Ye‘i’ĕl, the gatekeepers; [19] and the singers Hĕman, Asaph, and Ĕythan, were to sound the cymbals of bronze; [20] and Zeḵaryah, and Azi’ĕl, and Shemiramoth, and Yeḥi’ĕl, and Unni, and Eliyaḇ, and Ma‘asĕyahu, and Benayahu, with harps according to Alamoth; [21] and Mattithyahu, and Eliphelĕhu, and Miqnĕyahu, and Oḇĕḍ-Eḍom, and Ye‘i’ĕl, and Azazyahu, to lead with lyres on the Sheminith;

readings.title: Instructors and Gatekeepers
readings.subtitle: The Priests Before the Ark of Elohim
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 15:22] and Kenanyahu, leader of the Lĕvites in the song, instructed in the song because he was skilled; [23] and Bereḵyah and Elqanah were doorkeepers for the ark; [24] and Sheḇanyahu, and Yoshaphat, and Nethan’ĕl, and Amasai, and Zeḵaryahu, and Benayahu, and Eli‘ezer, the priests, were to blow the trumpets before the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn>. And Oḇĕḍ-Eḍom and Yeḥiyah, were doorkeepers for the ark.

readings.title: A Sealed Cycle of Seven: Bulls and Rams
readings.subtitle: Joyous Obedience to the Creator's Architecture
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 15:25] And it was Daviḍ and the elders of Yisra’ĕl, and the commanders over thousands, who went to bring up <dn>את</dn> the ark of the covenant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> from the house of Oḇĕḍ-Eḍom with joy. [26] And it came to be, when <dn>Elohim</dn> helped the Lĕvites who bore the ark of the covenant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, that they slaughtered seven bulls and seven rams. [27] And Daviḍ was dressed in a robe of fine linen, as were all the Lĕvites who bore <dn>את</dn> the ark, the singers, and Kenanyah the leader of the service with the singers. And Daviḍ wore a linen shoulder garment. [28] So all Yisra’ĕl brought up <dn>את</dn> the ark of the covenant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with shouting and with a voice of a shophar, with trumpets and with cymbals, sounding with harps and lyres.

readings.title: The Lifted Face: Ascending Six Steps
readings.subtitle: David Dances Before the Singular Being
readings.text: [2 Samuel 6:12] And it was reported to Sovereign Daviḍ, saying, “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has blessed <dn>את</dn> the house of Oḇĕḍ-Eḍom and <dn>את</dn> all that he has, because of the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn>.” Daviḍ then went and brought up <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>Elohim</dn> from the house of Oḇĕḍ-Eḍom to the City of Daviḍ with rejoicing. [13] And it came to be, when those bearing the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had gone six steps, that he slaughtered bulls and fatted sheep. [14] And Daviḍ danced before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with all his might. And Daviḍ was wearing a linen shoulder garment. [15] Thus Daviḍ and all the house of Yisra’ĕl brought up <dn>את</dn> the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with shouting and with a voice of a shophar.

readings.title: A Heart of Systemic Disharmony (Ra)
readings.subtitle: Despising the Pure Expression of Emunah
readings.text: [2 Samuel 6:16] And it came to be, when the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came into the City of Daviḍ, that Miḵal, daughter of Sha’ul, looked through a window and saw <dn>את</dn> Sovereign Daviḍ leaping and dancing before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and she despised him in her heart.

readings.title: Apportioning the Surplus of the Kingdom
readings.subtitle: Blessing the Congregation in the Name of YeHoVaH
readings.text: [2 Samuel 6:17] So they brought the ark of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in, and set <dn>את</dn> it in its place in the midst of the Tent that Daviḍ had pitched for it. And Daviḍ brought ascending offerings before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and peace offerings. [18] And when Daviḍ had finished bringing ascending offerings and peace offerings, he blessed <dn>את</dn> the people in the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts. [19] And he apportioned to all the people, to all the crowd of Yisra’ĕl, from man even to women, to each one a loaf of bread, and a measure, and a cake of raisins. And all the people left, each one to his house.

readings.title: The Inner Corruption of the House of Sha'ul
readings.subtitle: The Refusal of Absolute Humility
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 15:29] And it came to be, as the ark of the covenant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to the City of Daviḍ, that Miḵal the daughter of Sha’ul, looking through a window, saw <dn>את</dn> Sovereign Daviḍ dancing and playing. And she despised him in her heart.

readings.title: The Permanent Transfer of the Dynasty
readings.subtitle: Humility Before YeHoVaH vs. Earthly Esteem
readings.text: [2 Samuel 6:20] And Daviḍ returned to bless <dn>את</dn> his household, and Miḵal the daughter of Sha’ul came out to meet Daviḍ, and said, “How esteemed was the sovereign of Yisra’ĕl today, uncovering himself today in the eyes of the female servants of his servants, as one of the foolish ones shamelessly uncovers himself!” [21] So Daviḍ said to Miḵal, “Before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, who chose me instead of your father and all his house, commanded <dn>את</dn> me to be ruler over the people of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, over Yisra’ĕl, so I danced before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [22] “And I shall be even more slight than this, and shall be humble in my own eyes. But as for the female servants of whom you have spoken, by them I am esteemed.” [23] And Miḵal the daughter of Sha’ul had no children to the day of her death.
